#!name=美团 & 美团外卖

[MITM]
hostname = img.meituan.net, s3plus.meituan.net, flowplus.meituan.net

[Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/wmapi\.meituan\.com\/api\/v7\/(loadInfo|openscreen|startpicture)\?/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/(s3plus|flowplus)\.meituan\.net\/v\d\/\w+\/linglong\/\w+\.(gif|jpg|mp4)/i then reject_img(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/img\.meituan\.net\/bizad\/bizad_brandCpt_\d+\.jpg/i then reject_img(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/img\.meituan\.net\/goodsawardpic\/[a-f0-9]+\.png\.webp/i then reject_img(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/s3plus\.meituan\.net\/ocean-blk-index\/index\/blk_conf_73\.json/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/s3plus\.meituan\.net\/v1\/mss_\w+\/(brandcpt-vedio|waimai-alita)\/\w+\.zip$/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^http:\/\/59\.82\.113\.10\/amdc\/mobileDispatch\?appkey=213807&/i then reject_dict(200)
